turnaround_reason: Formerly ASGN, rebranded to Everforth in April 2026; IT staffing and federal-services provider (Apex Systems, ECS, Creative Circle, GlideFast) riding a soft IT-services demand cycle. Screener flagged it as basing, but the stock has already rallied hard off its $16.90 low back to $33.
bullish_points: Real, profitable business at a reasonable multiple: 7.7x forward earnings, 0.75x book, ~$213M FCF, positive net margin
Strong federal franchise via Apex Systems and ECS into a structural tailwind — the federal cyber/IT workforce gap exceeds 700,000 open roles
Cluster of insider open-market buying in April 2026 at $18-22 across multiple directors and officers signals internal conviction at the lows
bearish_points: Stock is extended, not basing: trading at ~139% of its 100-day MA and roughly double the 52-week low — the easy mean-reversion move is already behind it
Analyst target mean of $27.50 sits BELOW the current $33.26 price; the sell side sees ~17% downside, and consensus recommendation is 'none'
Fundamentals are deteriorating, not recovering: revenue flat-to-down, Q1 net income collapsed to $5.5M from $20.9M YoY, and net income is forecast to shrink ~27% next year
Commercial IT-services demand backdrop remains weak; the rebrand is cosmetic and does not change the demand cycle
catalyst: Q3 2026 earnings — needs evidence that commercial staffing demand has troughed and federal wins are offsetting; absent that, the recent rally lacks fundamental support.
suggested_trade: Pass at $33; watchlist only. Revisit on a pullback toward the $24-27 analyst-fair-value zone or a Q3 print that confirms a demand trough.
key_risk: Buying a name that has already rallied into deteriorating estimates and above analyst fair value — the setup is late, not early.
would_skip_if: Price is above the analyst target mean with earnings estimates still being revised down — which is the case today.
